findings.label: Bundled unrelated changes
findings.detail: persistRankLog on collectRankSelect and the rasRenderTest.ts publish-path PNG-path normalization are unrelated to the copywriter feature. Consider splitting them out or calling them out in the PR description.

findings.label: Caption attribution not schema-enforced
findings.detail: The 'Source: <url>' trailer is required only by prompt instruction, not by EditorialCopySchema, so an LLM-path caption can validate without it while the template fallback always includes it. Enforce via a .refine on caption or append the source line post-validation if attribution must be guaranteed.

findings.label: Redundant snippet slice
findings.detail: enrich() re-slices Exa text to 2000 chars though searchExa already caps text at 2000 via contents.text.maxCharacters. Harmless; drop for clarity.

findings.label: Exa enrichment path untested
findings.detail: The enrich() branch (snippet assembly, URL de-dup, fail-open on thrown search error) and the source-URL merge/de-dup in buildRasPayload have no direct unit test; copywriter tests run with Exa disabled. A stubbed-searchExa test would cover the grounding path.
